mentions.h: Welcome to the following new members who have joined since December 1993

mentions.note: AAA Grade I awards 100m, 200m, shot; shot club record 9.77
Thameside League Boys' best performance 1994; three Grade I standards as U13

photos.c: And what a talent this young man has. Moses Semakula has been taking the U13B sprints by storm. Moses won A.A.A. Grade I Awards in 100m, 200m and shot putt during the summer, the latter with a Club Record distance of 9.77.
